disclaimer.title: Liability Waiver Agreement
disclaimer.content:
By using our booking services, you acknowledge and agree to the following:

1. ASSUMPTION OF RISK
You understand that spa and beauty treatments carry inherent risks, including but not limited to allergic reactions, skin irritation, or other adverse effects.

2. HEALTH DISCLOSURE
You confirm that you have disclosed all relevant health conditions, allergies, and medications that may affect your treatment.

3. RELEASE OF LIABILITY
You agree to release Privé Spa, its employees, and contractors from any liability for injuries, damages, or losses arising from services provided, except in cases of gross negligence or willful misconduct.

4. CANCELLATION POLICY
Bookings may be subject to our cancellation policy. Please contact us if you need to reschedule or cancel.

5. CONSENT TO TREATMENT
By proceeding with this booking, you consent to receive the selected treatments and services.

If you have any questions or concerns, please contact us before proceeding with your booking.

landing.privacyPolicyContent:
PRIVÉ SPA DATA PRIVACY POLICY

Last Updated: January 2026

1. INFORMATION WE COLLECT
We collect personal information that you provide to us when booking our services, including:
- Name and contact details (email, phone number)
- Service preferences and booking history
- Health information relevant to treatments
- Payment information (processed securely by third parties)

2. HOW WE USE YOUR INFORMATION
We use your personal information to:
- Process and manage your bookings
- Communicate with you about your appointments
- Improve our services and customer experience
- Send promotional offers (with your consent)
- Comply with legal obligations

3. DATA SHARING AND DISCLOSURE
We do not sell, rent, or share your personal information with third parties except:
- Service providers who assist in our operations (payment processors, booking systems)
- When required by law or legal process
- To protect our rights and safety

4. DATA SECURITY
We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.

5. YOUR RIGHTS
You have the right to:
- Access your personal data
- Request correction of inaccurate data
- Request deletion of your data
- Withdraw consent for marketing communications
- Object to processing of your data

6. DATA RETENTION
We retain your personal information only as long as necessary for the purposes outlined in this policy or as required by law.

7. COOKIES AND TRACKING
Our website may use cookies to enhance your browsing experience. You can control cookie settings through your browser.

8. CONTACT US
For questions about this privacy policy or to exercise your rights, please contact us at:
Email: privacy@theprivespa.com
Website: https://theprivespa.com/group-data-privacy-policy

9. CHANGES TO THIS POLICY
We may update this privacy policy from time to time. We will notify you of any significant changes by posting the new policy on our website.

By using our services, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this Privacy Policy.
